house party protocol.instructions: Set system volume to 70%, open the Music app and start playing (shuffle the library if nothing is queued), and announce that the House Party Protocol is active.

clean slate protocol.instructions: Quit every open application except Finder, the terminal running JARVIS and the browser showing the JARVIS interface. List the apps first and get confirmation before quitting anything with unsaved work.

workshop protocol.instructions: Prepare a coding session: open Visual Studio Code (or Xcode if VS Code is missing), a terminal, and the browser. Turn on Do Not Disturb if possible. Report system diagnostics briefly.

lockdown protocol.instructions: Mute the volume, pause any media, and lock the screen (ctrl+cmd+q). Speak a one-line farewell first.

morning briefing.instructions: Give a crisp morning briefing: greeting, the time and date, local weather (use the weather tool), battery and system status, top 3 news headlines from a web search, and any calendar events today from the Calendar app via AppleScript if accessible. Show the key facts in a HUD panel.

eyes on protocol.instructions: Look through the webcam and give a tactical-style scene assessment: people present, what they are doing, objects of note, lighting. Display it in a HUD panel titled SCAN REPORT.
